name: greensun-hotel/timeline
title: Timeline
description: Sticky title column + scrolling list of year-stamped story entries.

default.title: Doors open
default.body: Green Sun is built on Chino Roces — a 5-storey hotel and events venue in a neighborhood that had been quietly waiting for it.

default.title: The Eye opens
default.body: Our flagship event hall hosts its first wedding. Then its first product launch. Then its first hundred dance floors.

default.title: A new rhythm
default.body: When the city paused, we kept rooms ready for medical workers and stranded travelers. The hotel stayed warm.

default.title: A decade in
default.body: Ten years of guests, partners, and crew. Refreshed rooms, new amenities, and a renewed commitment to quiet hospitality.

default.title: Still here
default.body: Magallanes is still our home. Travelers are still our guests. And there's still a sun on the wall.
